cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(DoubleBufferedStateTest)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Include directories
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

# Add the test executable
add_executable(test_double_buffered_state 
    test_double_buffered_state.cpp
)

# Add the example executable
add_executable(example_double_buffered_state 
    example_double_buffered_state.cpp
)

# Link pthread for threading support
target_link_libraries(test_double_buffered_state pthread)
target_link_libraries(example_double_buffered_state pthread)

# Compiler-specific options
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(test_double_buffered_state PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -pthread)
    target_compile_options(example_double_buffered_state PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -pthread)
endif()

if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(test_double_buffered_state PRIVATE /W4)
    target_compile_options(example_double_buffered_state PRIVATE /W4)
endif()
